sources.entry: Hongguo Drama - Unofficial player and downloader for Chinese short dramas from Hongguo, Xifan, and Hema, for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jackotom/hongguo-drama) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Unofficial macOS and Windows desktop app (Electron) for searching, playing, and downloading Chinese short dramas from the Hongguo, Xifan, and Hema sources.
summary.what_it_does: The app is a desktop player and downloader for short dramas from three sources: Hongguo, Xifan, and Hema. It offers unified search across sources, a discovery catalog with genre filters and hot-chart lists, and parsing of Hongguo share links or IDs. Playback can be online or from local files, with resume, auto-play, speed control, and a system picture-in-picture window. The download queue supports quality choices (auto, 1080P, 720P), 1 to 10 concurrent tasks, retries, and per-task status. Downloaded episodes can be merged into a single MP4 with fast or H.264-compatible modes, and the library tracks storage and cache cleanup. The README also describes a watch-history check for new episodes and sequel seasons, optional comment and danmaku display, and a custom source option for Apple CMS V10 APIs and direct MP4 or M3U8 links.
use_cases: download Chinese short dramas to a Mac or Windows PC
watch short dramas offline from local files
merge downloaded episodes into one MP4
search across Hongguo, Xifan and Hema at once
keep a small always-on-top window while watching
track new episodes of dramas I follow
how_to_run: Download the DMG (Apple silicon or Intel Mac, macOS 13+) or Windows x64 installer/portable EXE from the release page and launch the app
Source build (Mac): git clone the repository, then run npm ci
Source build (Mac): run npm run build:mac (requires Node.js 22.12+, Apple Command Line Tools, pkg-config, make, git, curl)
notable: Unofficial community fork; not an official client of Hongguo, Xifan, or Hema, and it does not sell paid episode unlocks
Mac builds are signed, notarized and stapled per the README; Windows EXEs are unsigned
Picture-in-picture reuses the current video element and a 400x600 always-on-top mini window mode with auto-pause
Source code includes a dedicated FFmpeg/x264 corresponding-source package for the bundled media tools
Built-in custom playback source support for Apple CMS V10 JSON APIs and direct MP4/M3U8 links (VOD only)
caveats: Downloads and playback depend on upstream platform availability, platform rate limits and region; the README does not guarantee every episode or quality works
Windows binaries are not code-signed and may trigger system security warnings
Licensed under GPL-3.0 for the software only; the README states no right to redistribute drama content, and the app ships no episode media
summary.license: GPL-3.0 (README states the project continues the upstream GPL-3.0 license; the README also refers to GPLv3)
